name: Boreas Autonomous Driving Dataset
description: Multi-season repeat-route autonomous driving dataset collected over more than an entire year by the Autonomous Space Robotics Lab at the University of Toronto. Features high-resolution 360-degree Navtech CIR304-H radar, Velodyne Alpha-Prime 128-beam LiDAR, FLIR Blackfly S camera, and high-precision Applanix POS LV GNSS/IMU. Designed to benchmark long-term localization, place recognition, odometry, and adverse-weather perception across repeated routes under diverse seasonal conditions (sun, rain, snow, nighttime).
